_comment: Pinned program for the count query 'How many players are visible?' on bernabeu-counter. Hits an op-path the hero chain never does: detect -> count -> answer (no crop/read_text/filter/temporal_order). The window 10000-10001ms @ fps1 samples exactly the single legible frame (10000), whose fixture-derived cache carries 5 person detections, so count grounds to '5'. A wider window would multiply the count across frames; this single-frame window is the count analogue of test_generalized_answer's 4625-4626 probe. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json. end_ms 10001 <= clip duration_ms 30086.
